_about: Breaker atoms (Q6166): how a panel schedule's breaker type codes and their legend meanings read as a breaker type, what a row says when it is a spare or a space, and what each type is bought as. A schedule's legend decides what its own codes mean; the code lists are the fallback for a code the legend does not define. Order matters: the first feature a code matches is its feature (equipment ground fault before personnel ground fault).
